entries.title: Ask HN: I'm quadriplegic – can you help me with my security?
entries.author: escapologybb
entries.current_title: Ask HN: I'm quadriplegic – can you help me with my security?
entries.excerpt: Hey Hacker News, I've run out of places to look so I hope you guys can help me with this. I would like to: 1. Securely login to my various websites 2. Securely lock and unlock my MacBook Pro. Easy, right? Except I'm quadriplegic. I use DragonDictate[1] to input text, and invoke keyboard shortcuts verbally, and SwitchXS[2] with a single button switch[3] (to move the mouse around and switch between applications etc). With these I have nearly total control over my laptop. I use
entries.guide_zh: 四肢瘫痪的用户想安全登录各类网站，求助兼顾安全与可操作性的方案。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (July 2013)

entries.excerpt: Please lead with the location of the position and include the keywords INTERN, REMOTE, or H1B if the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome. Feel free to post any job that may interest HN readers from executive assistant to machine learning expert to CTO. Also see: Ask HN: Freelancer? Seeking freelancer? (July 2013) https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=5970190

entries.title: Ask HN: HN Political News Overload?

entries.title: Ask HN: Take down my reverse-engineered Snapchat lib because they asked?
entries.author: tlack
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Take down my reverse-engineered Snapchat lib because they asked?
entries.excerpt: A few months ago, I spent a couple days reverse engineering the Snapchat protocol and wrote a quick and dirty library to use it in your own PHP apps: https://github.com/tlack/snaphax Today Snapchat has written me requesting that I take it offline: Hi Thomas, I'm writing to ask that you remove Snaphax from github and no longer publish or distribute it. Snapchat does not permit third party software to access our API and we consider Snaphax to be an unlawful circumvention device
entries.guide_zh: 逆向 Snapchat 后写出 PHP 库，收到下架请求的作者纠结是否配合。

entries.title: Ask HN: When did people start paying for your SaaS and why?
entries.author: n_coats
entries.current_title: Ask HN: When did people start paying for your SaaS and why?
entries.excerpt: When did people start paying for your SaaS? How many times did it take before you got it right? I don't suspect most people get it right on their first go, so what have you taken from your failures and what have been the biggest factors in your success in terms of gaining traction with your SaaS? In particular, what marketing/promo tactics have served you best?
entries.guide_zh: SaaS 用户什么时候开始付款，你试过多少次才找到愿意付费的需求？

entries.title: Ask HN: Has anyone here self-published a book? Any advice?
entries.author: desouzt
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Has anyone here self-published a book? Any advice?
entries.excerpt: Hi there, I am close to finishing my book and keen to get it published. I figured it would be easier to self publish (could be a wrong assertion), and wondered if anyone had any advice? Have you done it before? Anything to avoid? Anything I should definitely do? Any good sites to promote it on? N.B. The book isn't a technical book. It is a comedy book set out in the style of a blog. thanks!
entries.guide_zh: 书快写完了，作者向有自出版经验的人征求流程与注意事项。
